notes: Sentences extracted verbatim from corpus.ko.json (decoded Korean LeafGreen ROM dialog). Each entry's `source` field references its corpus record id. Word-spacing has been added for readability; the underlying ROM stores text without spaces. Korean glyphs may reflect minor OCR ambiguities from the charmap (rounds 1-16). areaId pins each line to the area it would naturally surface in (Pokédex entries for early-route Pokémon, system/item lines without a clear area = null).

entries.korean: 포켓몬을 잡기 쉽게 만들어진 매우 좋은 볼
entries.romanization: pokemon-eul japgi swibge mandeureojin maeu joeun bol
entries.gloss: A very good ball, made to make Pokémon easier to catch. (Ultra Ball.)

entries.korean: 깊은 물 속에 있는 포켓몬을 잡기 쉽다
entries.romanization: gipeun mul sog-e inneun pokemon-eul japgi swibda
entries.gloss: Easier to catch Pokémon that live deep in the water. (Net Ball.)

entries.korean: 전투 중인 포켓몬의 공격을 높이는 도구
entries.romanization: jeontu jung-in pokemon-ui gonggyeog-eul nopineun dogu
